challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: The current hand over between evaluation and the registry is a bottleneck that slows down every iteration we attempt. We need to automate the promotion pipeline so that a validated model moves from the evaluation environment to the registry and then into the deployment pipeline without manual intervention. This will let us test more variations of the demand forecasting logic and react to shifting store patterns much faster. The more automated this path becomes, the quicker we can refine the allocation logic for the middle aisle promotions. I want the entire sequence to run on its own so we are not waiting on manual clicks to verify a version that has already passed its internal checks.
output.reclassify_reason: The text states a need to automate the pipeline to speed up iterations, and the author explicitly desires the entire sequence to run on its own, indicating that increasing automation (doing more than the minimum) would make them happier.
